x: Pity you didn't write before Tom, as Ken would be very pleased to renew acquaintance. He also says Len Rollins is in the Navy.
Rodaway (Fleet Air Arm); Len Rollins (R.N.); Bert Footer (Royal Marines).

Charlie Strange is in the dark blue uniform of the Royal Navy, trimmed with gold braid, in keeping with his friend Len Rollins. Les Bennet, who, we understand, got away from Singapore to Batavia, and of whom more news is anxiously awaited.
Len Rollins has gained his second "ring" and is now a full Lieutenant, R.N.V.R.

Vests have been received from the following, with many thanks: Bob Boyden, Len Rollins and Ken O'Kell. Still more vests are required for new members, and any member having more than one who wishes to assist, please send to the Hon.

Len Rollins, R.N.V.R., "on board" H.M.S. Lochaibort, writes congratulatory messages to all those concerned in producing such a wonderful October "Belgravian." He says that running is part of his routine training, but as he is usually in the first three the standard must be low!
It is rumoured that he was married when on leave recently. Len Rollins writes from Ceylon about perpetual sweating. Is very busy and will be pleased to see any members who happen to be near H.M.S.
Sends the Club "Best Wishes" for the coming season. Len Rollins has also been promoted to Lt.-Commander, and has been in command of a camp of 700 at Ceylon.

Mine hosts were our old friend and fellow Belgravian Len Rollins and his charming wife, who furnished us with a most sumptious supper and wines, etc., at a most reasonable charge and in most comfortable and pleasant surroundings.
Len Rollins, one of our very keen members in pre-war years and one who still takes a very live interest in Club activities, has also been ill.
He was followed by Len Rollins who is always popping up. The recording went fairly smoothly until the 18th position after which no one seems quite sure what the order was.
JOE SCAMELL and BEN KNIFTON joined Belgrave in 1925, and the following year TOM MORELL, CHARLIE JONES, ALF HARLEY and LEN ROLLINS were accepted into membership.
JOHN FLOWER is back in England after sixteen months sojourn in the "White man's grave", and now has one ring on his sleeve. LEN ROLLINS is on board H.M.S.

I noticed Len Rollins looking very M.C.-ish, dancing with that air of detached boredom which characterises the really good dancer, as distinct from the plebian, chance-to-the-luck-and-the-girl's-good-temper enthusiasts [illegible]ke ourselves.
